deliverables: DeFi Kernel Registry Website and Submission Process
Public reporting, milestone reviews, security review or audit reports, and final impact/work package reports
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dano Finance's DeFi Kernel adoption work, two DeFi Kernel-compatible primitives, and a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% budget administration fee.
Dano Finance says Cardano DeFi is fragmented across liquidity, metadata, and execution paths, which slows integrations and limits advanced financial applications.
The DeFi Kernel is described as an open, fee-free, royalty-free compatibility standard for permissionless, composable, and discoverable Cardano DeFi contracts.

The registry platform is intended to document script hashes, datum and redeemer schemas, integration steps, off-chain libraries, audit or security status, TVL references, and other metadata for ecosystem integrators.
Dano Finance claims it currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.
The proposal allocates 300,000 ADA to the registry work package and 1,000,000 ADA each to the Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Protocol, and SDK work packages.

The Spot Leverage Order Book work package will deliver protocol design, testnet deployment, security review or audit, mainnet release, published script hashes and schemas, adoption reports, and integration documentation.

The American Options Protocol work package will deliver an extended concentrated-pool model for American options market-making with strike, expiry, premium, collateral, exercise, settlement, and LP risk accounting behavior.

The SDK work package will provide registry schema reading, metadata parsing, discovery helpers, transaction construction helpers, protocol adapters, examples, tests, package distribution, and integration documentation.

Dano Finance commits to return 5% of protocol fees from the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after specified direct costs, with public reporting.

summary: The document requests 3,333,000 ADA for Dano Finance to build DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with Minswap Labs as administrator; it provides work packages, milestones, KPIs, and accountability mechanisms, but the deterministic assessment identifies missing budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
